intro_mara_02.text: Mara: Expired. Very funny, Selin. Very... Selin?

echo_first_contact.text: ECHO: Dr. Voss. You are in Sublevel Nine, Biohazard Sector C.

log_11.text: Dr. Selin Aslan: Mara, if you're listening to this, I'm probably dead. X-7 does NOT just infect. It integrates.

yusuf_intro.text: Yusuf: Don't move. Don't — wait. Mara? Mara Voss? Your arm... you're infected.

mahmoud_intro.text: Mahmoud: Mara. I'm relieved. I was beginning to think the inoculation had failed entirely.

mahmoud_phase_two.text: Mahmoud: ...The world is... going to burn anyway. You know... that.

mahmoud_phase_three.text: Mahmoud: ...mara... i'm... still here... i'm sorry...

final_choice_ready.text: ECHO: Dr. Voss. Your mutation level is at eighty-one percent. The suppressor will still work if administered now.

lore_tariq.text: Dr. Mahmoud Alifqara: There is no such thing as too far when the boy's name was Tariq and no one else was there.

lore_selin_unsent.text: Dr. Selin Aslan: Mahmoud recruited you specifically because of the Syntex incident. Be careful.
